name: Selective London Python engineer

context.geography: London; considering European product companies that employ remote workers based in the UK
constraints: Already has a shortlist of 15 employers
Remote work from the UK must be explicitly supported
context.company_awareness: High employer awareness; knows 15 target employers but has not discovered Job Seek

trigger: A team reorganisation makes another year at the current employer less appealing. A bookmarked role at a preferred employer closes before the engineer notices it, prompting a search for a low-maintenance way to follow the shortlist.

search_journey.need: Find plausible opportunities without leaving London.
search_journey.fit_reason: Relevant role and location filters exist, but broad discovery does not yet use the existing employer shortlist.

search_journey.need: Survey whether an attractive move is available.
search_journey.fit_reason: Useful discovery filters; Europe alone does not establish UK employment eligibility.

search_journey.query: software engineering jobs with salary listed
search_journey.english_gloss: software engineering jobs with salary listed
search_journey.need: Avoid investing in roles with unknown compensation.
search_journey.fit_reason: Salary filters help where postings disclose compensation; completeness needs evidence.

search_journey.query: senior python backend engineer remote UK salary Europe product companies
search_journey.english_gloss: senior python backend engineer remote UK salary Europe product companies
search_journey.need: Combine core role, location and pay needs.
search_journey.fit_reason: Several filters fit, but company type and source completeness remain checks.

search_journey.query: backend engineer jobs without on call
search_journey.english_gloss: backend engineer jobs without on call
search_journey.need: Avoid roles with an operational rota.
search_journey.fit_reason: Pro description checks can assess explicit statements; missing policy cannot count as absence.

search_journey.query: European tech companies hiring remotely in the UK
search_journey.english_gloss: European tech companies hiring remotely in the UK
search_journey.need: Check which companies can accommodate the UK location.
search_journey.fit_reason: Company discovery helps, but role-specific source evidence is needed.

search_journey.english_gloss: English speaking backend jobs Europe remote
search_journey.need: Avoid openings requiring another working language.
search_journey.fit_reason: Posting-language filtering is useful but does not verify workplace language.

search_journey.need: Replace repeated visits to the existing shortlist.
search_journey.fit_reason: Company selection plus saved searches and email alerts directly address the workflow.

search_journey.need: Find monitoring that also handles a deal-breaker in description text.
search_journey.fit_reason: Core monitoring fits and Pro checks add description criteria, with unknowns preserved.

search_journey.english_gloss: LinkedIn job alerts only companies I choose
search_journey.need: Try an already familiar platform before adding another account.
search_journey.fit_reason: A useful alternative-oriented entry point, provided comparisons are tested and accurate.

search_journey.need: Compare a retrieved monitoring tool with a search that includes pay.
search_journey.fit_reason: Job Seek can demonstrate salary search and additional description criteria without making unsupported competitor claims.

search_journey.query: how to tell if remote Europe jobs accept UK applicants
search_journey.english_gloss: how to tell if remote Europe jobs accept UK applicants
search_journey.need: Resolve ambiguous remote labels before applying.
search_journey.fit_reason: A source-reading guide could lead to the product, but employer confirmation may still be necessary.

search_journey.need: Verify that the existing shortlist can be followed.
search_journey.fit_reason: Coverage is the decisive activation test; missing-company requests are available.

search_journey.query: Job Seek free job alerts multiple companies
search_journey.english_gloss: Job Seek free job alerts multiple companies
search_journey.need: Set up a small number of useful alerts.
search_journey.fit_reason: Free search and alerts fit; explain grouping and the ten-watchlist limit clearly.

searches_run.query: senior python backend engineer remote UK salary Europe product companies
searches_run.observation: Retrieval returned recruiter listings, job aggregators and direct employer/ATS pages. Several snippets displayed salary ranges, but remote wording ranged from UK to Europe/EMEA. The opened KoreLabs employer page includes a salary band and UK/EU work-rights wording; its text does not specify an on-call policy. This is a mixed retrieval sample, not a ranking study.

searches_run.query: get job alerts from specific companies careers pages keyword filters no on call
searches_run.observation: Retrieval surfaced JobBeacon, forum discussions and general alert advice. The opened JobBeacon page markets employer-career-page monitoring with keyword/location filtering and email alerts. Its described feature set does not establish a filter for confirmed absence of on-call duties.

sources.title: Senior Backend Engineer — KoreLabs Cloud
sources.supports: Directly opened employer page describes remote Europe, Python among acceptable languages, a €85,000–€115,000 base band and EU/UK work-rights requirements. No on-call policy appears in the retrieved page text; absence does not prove no on-call.

sources.title: Senior Python Backend Engineer — Fully Remote, UK | interAct Consulting
sources.supports: Search result snippet presents a recruiter listing with explicit UK-based remote wording and a salary range. Not independently opened or checked for availability.

sources.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases Pyroscope | UK | Remote at Grafana Labs
sources.supports: Search result snippet presents a direct ATS page with UK remote wording and a country-specific compensation range. It does not establish a Python-primary role or suitability for this persona.

sources.title: JobBeacon - Career Page Monitor & Job Posting Alerts
sources.supports: Directly opened vendor page advertises tracking company career pages, keyword/location filters and email notifications, plus a comparison with manual checking and LinkedIn alerts. These are vendor claims, not independently tested capabilities.

best_entry_page.promise: Follow selected employers and receive email alerts for roles matching saved search filters; check description text for additional criteria while keeping missing details visible as unknown.
best_entry_page.cta: Check whether your target employers are covered, then save a filtered search.
proof_needed: An indexable acquisition page must be created; current search and company pages are noindex.
Show actual coverage for the visitor’s 15 employers and the missing-company request route.
Demonstrate a multi-company saved search so 15 employers are not confused with the free limit of 10 watchlists.
Show a real alert and source posting, with timestamp semantics accurately explained.
Demonstrate distinct handling of explicit no-on-call, explicit on-call and unknown policy.
Show UK eligibility evidence separately from generic remote-Europe wording.
Explain that description checks are Pro at $10/month after a seven-day trial while base alerts and search are free.

conversion_objections: Are all 15 companies covered, and what happens when one is missing?
Does remote Europe really include UK-based employees for this role?
Will missing salary or on-call information silently pass my criteria?
Can I group employers in one alert rather than setting up 15 separate searches?
Does description matching save enough time to justify Pro when basic company alerts are free?
Will broad titles such as software engineer be missed by a Python/backend-only search?
Will emails create another inbox chore rather than reduce checking?

avoid_targeting.query: guaranteed remote UK jobs no on call
avoid_targeting.reason: Eligibility and on-call policy require source evidence; monitoring cannot guarantee either.
This persona values selectivity and the product does not demonstrate auto-apply.
Compensation calculations are outside the demonstrated product and the immediate alerting need.

avoid_targeting.query: best companies with no on call engineering
avoid_targeting.reason: A definitive employer-wide list would overgeneralise team-specific policies without verified evidence; only an evidence-qualified guide would be credible.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I already know where I would consider moving, so help me stop checking fifteen careers pages. I would try your free alerts if coverage is clear, and consider paying for description checks if you show me what is confirmed and what I still need to ask about UK hiring, pay and on-call.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic scenario, not an interview or measured customer behaviour. Only two representative queries were browsed; all other searches are hypotheses. Retrieval confirms examples of employer monitoring positioning and posting-level salary/location detail, not query volume, ranking difficulty, conversion, coverage, listing freshness or employer legitimacy. The main opportunity is reducing repeated shortlist checking; the hardest constraint is treating silence about on-call or UK eligibility as unknown.
